title: Constant realization reflects algebraic derived isomorphisms locally
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U\to X$ be a nonempty object of its small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $R$ be a commutative ring. Use constant module sheaves [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor] and the derived constant realization $c:D(R)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\underline R)$ [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor], where the derived categories and module sheaves are [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every $C\in D(R)$ and integer $i$, there is a natural isomorphism $H^i(c(C)|_U)\cong\underline{H^i(C)}|_U$. For every morphism $f:C\to D$ in $D(R)$, if $c(f)|_U$ is an isomorphism in the derived category on the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], then $f$ is an isomorphism in $D(R)$. Here $\underline R$ and $\underline{H^i(C)}$ are the constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. No boundedness, finite-generation, or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.
